triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: During the preceding month it had been several times suggested to him that his brother Ivan was in love with Katerina Ivanovna, and, what was more, that he meant “to carry her off” from Dmitri.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Meantime, Dmitri had said outright on the previous day that he was glad that Ivan was his rival, and that it was a great assistance to him, Dmitri.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: During the preceding month it had been several times suggested to him that his brother Ivan was in love with Katerina Ivanovna

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: He loved both his brothers, and dreaded such rivalry between them.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Alyosha had till the evening before implicitly believed that Katerina Ivanovna had a steadfast and passionate love for Dmitri; but he had only believed it till the evening before.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Now Alyosha was impressed by Madame Hohlakov’s blunt and persistent assertion that Katerina Ivanovna was in love with Ivan, and only deceived herself through some sort of pose

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: “One reptile will devour the other,” Ivan had pronounced the day before, speaking in anger of his father and Dmitri.

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: by the side of two such friends as you and your brother I still feel strong—for I know—you two will never desert me.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: simply a token of sympathy, of a desire to assist him from me, Dmitri Fyodorovitch’s betrothed, not from himself

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: She has known all the time that I cared for her—though I never said a word of my love to her—she knew, but she didn’t care for me.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: For you’re torturing Ivan, simply because you love him—and torturing him, because you love Dmitri through ‘self-laceration’

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: I am going now; but, believe me, Katerina Ivanovna, you really love him. And the more he insults you, the more you love him

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Dmitri Fyodorovitch somehow lost his temper with this captain, seized him by the beard and dragged him out into the street

triples.subject: Snegiryov
triples.quote: He lives in Lake Street, in the house of a woman called Kalmikov

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: She had two hundred-rouble notes in her hand.

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: Oh, how I love her, especially sometimes, and how glad I am again of everything!

triples.subject: Yulia
triples.quote: Run and say, Yulia, that I’ll fly to her.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: “I somehow fancied all at once,” Alyosha went on as though he had not heard Lise, “that she loved Ivan

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: ch—such an excellent and cultivated young man, who loves her more than anything in the world.
